'''Prine''' was a mostly-uninhabited [[Desert/Legends|desert]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated on the way between [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] and [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]]. It also possessed [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] where agriculture was possible.

==History==
[[Dass Jennir]] and [[Ember Chankeli]] crash-landed on Prine aboard [[Dezono Qua's starship]] after being attacked by two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]].
